'''2009 Bespin Regionals Matt Scott DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Scott]] at [[2009 Bespin Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|EJP-D-courtofthevilegangster.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' matt's deck D
* '''Username:''' 766014
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
